# Tigreal SOFT Initiation Map

The best Tigreal paths win geometry before they ever spend hard crowd control.

## What to watch

- Threaten the cut-off, not just the dash path.
- Time movement with the arriving lane, not after it.
- Make fog and wall shape carry half the setup.

## SOFT angle

SOFT favors Tigreal because his route can author the fight before the button press exists.

> The engage starts where the enemy loses safe geometry.

More on Tigreal: keep this read connected to tank roam structures, not just isolated mechanics.
